title: Rho button
description: Squared 6px buttons in three kinds: mint-filled with ink text that deepens on hover, a hairline outline that takes a faint tint, and an inverse light/ink one. Calm 0.16s colour changes.
notes: the inverse kind is white on dark sections and ink on light ones
name: rho-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: mint fill · outline: hairline border, no fill · inverse: text-coloured fill (white on dark, ink on light)

props.name: type
props.description: button type when no href is given
